steps.text: Every shape assertion below runs AFTER the settings identity pane is reached, so no step races the render. #identity-code retains the wizard's rendered value (nothing clears it), which is what makes the cross-pane arm meaningful.

NA-0753 (R377 section 3): STRENGTHENED, not weakened. The on-screen form became six 5-digit groups (v2 item 2), so the raw-shape needle /^[0-9]{30}$/ is replaced by TWO assertions that together pin strictly more: the GROUP shape, and the 30-digit payload recovered by stripping whitespace. Old shape: 30 bare digits. New shape: 48291 07365 51482 90173 66204 18859. The raw value itself stays pinned by the Rust value tests, untouched.

W2 on screen: the RETIRED grouped, check-charactered form (measured at the old pin as 4527-910E-41BB-92B4-V, 21 rendered chars) must appear NOWHERE in the rendered document. The brief called this the '16-char form'; 16 is the PAYLOAD length, not the rendered length.
Cross-pane arm (R365 section 3, seat's discretion): ADDED. The existing ops express it with no engine edit and no stash — one exec compares both slots directly.
